summary: Milo slams a dented copper bypass valve onto a scarred wooden workbench, causing a cloud of fine grey dust to rise between him and Arvin. Arvin doesn't flinch, instead reaching out to measure the valve’s warped circumference with a pair of antique brass calipers.
settingText: Interior of the nomadic tanker workshop.

dialogueInline.text: If this is off by even a millimeter, the pressure will turn this entire cabin into a pressurized coffin.

directionInline.text: ACTION — Milo slams a dented copper bypass valve onto a scarred wooden workbench, causing a cloud of fine grey dust to rise between him and Arvin. Arvin doesn't flinch, instead reaching out to measure the valve’s warped circumference with a pair of antique brass calipers.
SUBTEXT — Milo’s impulsiveness versus Arvin’s rigid, desperate need for structural perfection.
CAMERA / PERFORMANCE — Capture the contrast between Milo's heavy-handed slam and Arvin's delicate, precise measurement.
CONTINUITY — The dented copper bypass valve.

summary: Lucia slides a salvaged micro-thruster into the deep interior pocket of her heavy canvas vest, her movements fluid and practiced. Arvin watches her from across the cramped engine bay, his hands suspended mid-air as he holds a heavy soldering iron near a cluster of frayed wires.
settingText: The engine bay of the 'Launch-Shop' tanker.

dialogueInline.text: We need to stop thinking about communication and start thinking about impact trajectories, Arvin.

directionInline.text: ACTION — Lucia slides a salvaged micro-thruster into the deep interior pocket of her heavy canvas vest, her movements fluid and practiced. Arvin watches her from across the cramped engine bay, his hands suspended mid-air as he holds a heavy soldering iron near a cluster of frayed wires.

CONTINUITY — The salvaged micro-thruster and Lucia's canvas vest.

summary: Cyrus walks slowly through the center of a smoldering launch crater, his heavy tactical boots crunching into the scorched limestone crust. He stops to pick up a jagged piece of stamped sheet metal, turning it over to inspect a crude, hand-painted serial number with a look of cold recognition.
settingText: An abandoned launch site in the deep desert.

dialogueInline.text: He’s still using the old architecture, even when he’s building out of a trash heap.
